text:
jamie: Heads-up — two customer asks landed this morning. One wants better CLI/SDK ergonomics (bulk mutate, local dev sync, better auth flows). Other is saying they won't sign Dedicated without a console-driven model pinning + rollout UI. Do we prioritize API/SDK/CLI work (reduce developer friction) or Console polish (platform completeness for sales)?

maria: Need a rubric. Proposing a quick RICE pass to compare, plus explicit launch criteria and sequencing.

devon: Quick reality check — CLI/SDK changes are smaller ( ~3 eng-weeks). Console rollout UI is larger (8–10 wks) and needs design + infra for audit logs. CLI gives immediate dev productivity wins.

leo: From sales: enterprise deals are asking for console + rollout UX. Without that we lose two large prospects. High strategic impact.

sara: DevEx perspective — CLI helps onboarding and PLG conversion. Customers can script things today but it's fragile. CLI would be wide-reaching.

maria: Quick RICE pass (very rough):
```
CLI/SDK: Reach=0.6, Impact=7, Confidence=0.7, Effort=3 -> RICE=(0.6*7*0.7)/3 ~= 0.98
Console Rollout UI: Reach=0.4, Impact=9, Confidence=0.6, Effort=9 -> RICE=(0.4*9*0.6)/9 ~= 0.24
```

devon: Numbers make sense but RICE downplays strategic deals. Suggest adding a deal-weight multiplier for strategic enterprise signings.

maria: Agreed — propose a "deal-risk" multiplier (1.5x) for features that unblock committed ARR.

leo: If we apply 1.5x to console RICE it becomes ~0.36. Still lower than CLI, but that doesn't capture non-linear revenue impact if deals close. I'll add ARR estimates.

alex: Console scope breakdown (MVP vs Phase 2):
- MVP: model pinning, manual rollback, minimal audit trail
- Phase 2: canary rollout slider, percent traffic routing, metrics integration, full audit logs
MVP looks doable in 4–6 wks if backend endpoints exist.

jamie: Suggested launch criteria (both CLI & Console MVP):
- End-to-end tests + CI job
- Docs & sample recipes
- Telemetry for adoption + errors
- 2 customer pilots (for console: at least 1 paying enterprise)
- Clear rollback plan and feature flagging

sara: Sequencing options:
A) Build CLI -> Console MVP -> Console Phase 2 (keeps PLG momentum)
B) Console MVP first (to unblock deals) -> CLI (risk: delays PLG improvements)

maria: Risk analysis: A keeps product-led funnel healthy; B prioritizes short-term revenue/commitments. Which minimizes net risk?

devon: Engineering constraints — we have 1 frontend eng and 2 backend engs available this quarter. If we try to do both, both progress will be slow. I recommend a focused sprint on CLI (fast win) then allocate frontend for console next sprint.

jamie: Can we parallelize backend work for console (APIs, audit events) while devs build the CLI? That might shorten end-to-end time without blocking sales.

maria: Action items: I'll run a formal RICE with sales ARR numbers and include deal-weight. Will propose final sequence by EOD Friday. @leo can you send ARR + close timing for the two prospects?

leo: Will send ARR estimates and close windows by noon. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder — sprint planning meeting tomorrow 10:00am. :calendar:

maria: bump — any objections to scope/criteria above? if none, i'll book 8 design hours for console MVP and mark CLI as high priority for next sprint.

(no further replies)
